item.title: Implementing the CubeHash hashing algorithm in Rust
item.description:
Background #

Back during the dark gloomy days of the COVID pandemic, I set out to put my time to good use and teach myself Rust (among other, less esoteric endeavors like sourdough bread). My starting point was obviously to follow the Rust manual but I was eager to get my hands dirty and code something that would go beyond the canned examples provided in the guide without being overly complex to keep me motivated to follow through with my learning experience. At the same time, I was also digging into the technical details of how Bitcoin works which led me down a hashing algorithm rabbit hole that ended (or started, really) with looking at the submissions for the NIST Hash Function Competition.
